title: OVOGO: Offline Value-Guided On-Policy Generative Optimization for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action models can benefit from robot experience collected during deployment, but repeatedly acquiring new physical interactions for policy improvement is costly. Offline reinforcement learning provides a natural way to reuse collected experience, while flow-based policies offer an additional opportunity because fresh generation trajectories can be cheaply resampled from the current policy at replay observations. This motivates separating offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process. We propose OVOGO, an offline reinforcement learning framework that realizes this separation for flow-based VLAs. A central challenge in this formulation is to learn a critic that remains grounded in logged robot experience while providing useful value signals for newly generated actions. translated_title: OVOGO：面向基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的离线价值引导在线策略生成优化
translated_abstract: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以从部署期间收集的机器人经验中受益，但为了改进策略而反复获取新的物理交互成本高昂。离线强化学习提供了一种自然的重用已收集经验的方式，而基于流的策略还带来了额外的机会：在重放观测处可以从当前策略低成本地重新采样新的生成轨迹。这启发我们将离线价值学习与生成过程的在线策略优化分离开来。我们提出了OVOGO，一个为基于流的VLA实现这种分离的离线强化学习框架。该设定中的一个核心挑战是学习一个评价器，它既能扎根于已记录的机器人经验，又能为新近生成的动作提供有用的价值信号。OVOGO引入了一种回报锚定排序评价器，它将样本内分布式价值学习与具有保证的……相结合。
tldr: OVOGO提出了一种离线强化学习框架，通过回报锚定排序评价器，将离线价值学习与基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型生成过程的在线策略优化相分离，从而以低成本重用机器人经验来改进策略。
en_tdlr: OVOGO proposes an offline RL framework that separates offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process in flow-based vision-language-action models, using a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic to cheaply reuse robot experience for policy improvement.
